BillHeading.BriefDescription: Removing the state preemption of local regulations pertaining to residency restrictions for persons convicted of sex offenses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to removing the state preemption of local regulations pertaining to residency restrictions for persons convicted of sex offenses; and repealing RCW 9.94A.8445.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 9.94A.8445 (Community protection zones—Preemption of local regulations—Retrospective application) and 2006 c 131 s 1 are each repealed.
